english.note: Use 睇法 as the all-purpose Cantonese noun for someone's opinion, assessment, or perspective.

exampleSentences.english: I want to hear your take on this matter.
exampleSentences.traditional: 我想聽吓你對呢件事嘅睇法。
exampleSentences.jyutping: ngo5 soeng2 teng1 haa5 nei5 deoi3 ni1 gin6 si6 ge3 tai2 faat3

english.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial noun for a person's view or opinion.

exampleSentences.jyutping: ni1 go3 hai6 ngo5 ge3 tai2 faat3

english.note: This is the all-purpose everyday choice for someone's attitude or point of view.

exampleSentences.english: I respect your outlook, but I don't agree.
exampleSentences.traditional: 我尊重你嘅睇法，但係我唔同意。
exampleSentences.jyutping: ngo5 zyun1 zung6 nei5 ge3 tai2 faat3 daan6 hai6 ngo5 m4 tung4 ji3

english.note: Use this colloquial choice when emphasizing someone's personal way of looking at an issue.

exampleSentences.english: I have my own opinion on this matter.
exampleSentences.traditional: 我對呢件事有自己嘅睇法。
exampleSentences.jyutping: ngo5 deoi3 ni1 gin6 si6 jau5 zi6 gei2 ge3 tai2 faat3

english.note: Use this colloquial word when you mean someone's opinion or way of thinking rather than a physical or narrative perspective.

exampleSentences.english: I understand your point of view, but I still want to postpone it.
exampleSentences.traditional: 我明白你嘅睇法，但我都係想延期。
exampleSentences.jyutping: ngo5 ming4 baak6 nei5 ge3 tai2 faat3 daan6 ngo5 dou1 hai6 soeng2 jin4 kei4

english.note: Use this when belief means someone's view or opinion about whether a claim is true, rather than a firm conviction.

exampleSentences.english: My belief about this matter is different from yours.
exampleSentences.traditional: 我對呢件事嘅睇法同你唔同。
exampleSentences.jyutping: ngo5 deoi3 ni1 gin6 si6 ge3 tai2 faat3 tung4 nei5 m4 tung4

english.note: Use this as the all-purpose spoken choice for an opinion or a personal point of view.

exampleSentences.english: What’s your view on this matter?
exampleSentences.jyutping: nei5 deoi3 ni1 gin6 si6 jau5 me1 tai2 faat3

english.note: Use this for a judgement or view formed from noticing something.

exampleSentences.english: My observation is that they should have said it earlier.
exampleSentences.traditional: 我嘅睇法係，佢應該早啲講。
exampleSentences.jyutping: ngo5 ge3 tai2 faat3 hai6 keoi5 jing1 goi1 zou2 di1 gong2

english.note: Use this for someone's opinion, outlook, or personal view rather than their comprehension of a subject.

exampleSentences.english: What's your understanding of the situation?
exampleSentences.jyutping: nei5 deoi3 gin6 si6 jau5 me1 tai2 faat3

english.note: Use this for a person's general opinion or assessment rather than an official ruling.

exampleSentences.english: After reading the report, what is your verdict?
exampleSentences.traditional: 睇完份報告，你嘅睇法係點？
exampleSentences.jyutping: tai2 jyun4 fan6 bou3 gou3 nei5 ge3 tai2 faat3 hai6 dim2

english.note: Use 睇法 for someone's opinion, viewpoint, or attitude on a matter.

exampleSentences.english: What's your feeling about this matter?
exampleSentences.jyutping: nei5 deoi3 ni1 gin6 si6 jau5 me1 tai2 faat3

english.note: Use this when viewpoint means someone's way of seeing or opinion, rather than a literal or geometric angle.

exampleSentences.jyutping: ngo5 ming4 baak6 nei5 ge3 tai2 faat3
